constraints.definition: CHECK (((("collectionWindowSchemaVersion" = 0) AND ("collectionOpenAt" IS NULL) AND ("collectionCloseAt" IS NULL)) OR (("collectionWindowSchemaVersion" = 1) AND (("collectionOpenAt" IS NULL) OR ("collectionCloseAt" IS NULL) OR ("collectionOpenAt" < "collectionCloseAt")))))
CHECK ((("opensAt" IS NULL) OR ("expiresAt" IS NULL) OR ("opensAt" < "expiresAt")))

scope: Development PostgreSQL after migration; hashes exclude only the four additive columns. Every existing version remains schema 0/null and every existing publication has a null open time.
